newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Nov 1-20 palm oil exports 462,394t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Nov 1-20 palm oil exports 462,394t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for November 1-20 at 462,394 tonnes against 514,229 tonnes in October 1-20.
It said the exports comprised 147,142 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 171,782 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 50,605 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 92,865 tonnes.
China, which was the main buyer during the period, taking 72,400 tonnes, Egypt at 45,500 tonnes, Pakistan at 43,100 tonnes and India at 41,537 tonnes.
Countries in the European Union bought 35,893 tonnes.
